## Friction-to-fix pipeline

`loomctl friction` records repeated annoyances without creating notification noise. Exact normalized repeats graduate at 3, 6, and 10 occurrences, then Discord receives a bounded automation, configuration, purchase, habit, or investigation candidate.

Before publishing, select the **Loom personal intake** Header Auth credential on the webhook and **GuildedThorn Gaming Drop Discord** on the final node. Static data is intentionally capped at 100 friction records.
